projects.title: E-commerce Clickstream Pipeline (Java, Kafka, MongoDB)
projects.description:
• Built an event-driven backend pipeline in Java that simulates and processes real-time e-commerce clickstream data using sealed interfaces and records to model heterogeneous event types, enabling compile-time-enforced exhaustive handling that turns unhandled event types into build failures instead of silent runtime gaps.
• Built a Kafka producer/consumer pair with custom Serializer/Deserializer classes (Jackson-based polymorphic JSON serialization) and a partitioning strategy (keying by persistent anonymous ID) that preserves per-client event ordering across the login boundary.
• Persisted heterogeneous event streams to type-specific MongoDB collections, aligning each document’s schema with its record’s natural shape to avoid sparse relational tables and unnecessary joins.

projects.title: Snake Game (Java, Swing)
projects.description:
• Built a Snake game from scratch in Java via Swing, implementing a custom render loop via javax.swing.Timer and paintComponent, win/lose states, and live score tracking.
• Designed a buffered input queue with directional validation to eliminate a race-condition bug where rapid key presses let the snake reverse into itself.
